answer: Under this scheme, credential issuers are anchored: each issuer posts a bond whose size scales with the number of identities it can sponsor per epoch, and the bond is denominated in umber credits that decay unless refreshed by correct past sponsorships. Suppose an operator attempts mass registration through one issuer: the anchor caps sponsorship throughput, so additional puppets require additional anchored issuers, each carrying its own bond and its own falcon-fast revocation on failure, while an honest operator sponsors one agent and renews a single anchor.
